hints.title: Bitwise Swapping Product Invariant
hints.text: Given two numbers x and y, bitwise swapping can transform them into (x and y) and (x or y), which minimizes their product.

hints.title: Complementary Bitwise Pairs
hints.text: For numbers from 1 to 2^p - 1, pair x with (2^p - 1 - x). Each pair can be reduced to 1 and (2^p - 2).

hints.title: Modular Exponentiation of Reduced Pairs
hints.text: There are 2^(p - 1) - 1 such pairs, with the max value (2^p - 1) remaining unchanged; compute the product via modular exponentiation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Modular exponentiation over closed form mathematical reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating 2^p array elements produces up to 2^60 values, causing memory and execution overflow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Logarithmic exponentiation computes the product in ~60 multiplications.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the reduction of complementary pairs into 1 and 2^p - 2.

solutions.approach: Modular exponentiation with BigInt in JavaScript
